decision: A — approved by eye on canvas #060709 (2026-10-22)
rules: Every state change is a whole ladder rung (never a half rung).
Resolved level = clamp(rest + offset, S0, S8).
At the ceiling (rest = S8), hover uses offset -1 instead of +1, so it remains a full rung.
Active below the floor clamps to S0 (on canvas, S1 - 2 becomes S0).
Focus never changes the fill. It draws a ring on top of the current state fill: inner line at fill+1, a 2px gap, then outer line at fill+2.
Hover and focus can both apply: fill comes from hover, ring from focus.
Disabled is -1 from rest and keeps the element visible but inactive.
Press is stronger than hover on purpose (-2 vs +1).
assumptions: Ring line widths (2px) and gap (2px) are a specification choice, not from the measured policy. Confirm by eye.
Focus is a shape-only state (§6.7.5). §6.8 table lists focus as +1; this file follows §6.7.5. Please confirm if §6.8 should win.
Ceiling rule for hover (-1 at S8) follows §6.8 point 4; it is not yet checked visually on S8.
